description: This file implements the CompositeInput plugin for WPEFramework, handling device input events, registration of RPC methods, and event notifications related to composite input devices, signals, and video modes.

classes.name: CompositeInput
classes.description: Main plugin class managing composite input devices, events, and RPC methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and IARM communication.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startCompositeInput
methods.description: Starts composite input on a specified port.

methods.name: setVideoRectangleWrapper
methods.description: Sets the video rectangle (scale) for the input.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Performs the scaling of video input.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves list of composite input devices.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available composite input devices.

methods.name: compositeInputHotplug
methods.description: Handles hotplug events for input devices.

methods.name: compositeInputSignalChange
methods.description: Handles signal change events for input devices.

methods.name: compositeInputStatusChange
methods.description: Handles status change events for input devices.

methods.name: compositeInputVideoModeUpdate
methods.description: Handles video mode update events for input devices.

methods.name: dsCompositeSignalStatusEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for signal status events.

methods.name: dsCompositeStatusEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for device status events.

methods.name: dsCompositeVideoModeEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for video mode update events.
